study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Loreto et al., Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Alzheimer's disease heterogeneity revealed by neuroanatomical normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The reference cohort (n=33,072) was compiled from nine publicly available datasets listed in Supplementary Table 1: ABCD, Cam-CAN, CNP, FCON, HCP, OASIS-3, PNC, TOP, and UK Biobank. The normative model was previously trained on this reference cohort under a prior study (Verdi et al.). The adaptation dataset (n=20) consisted of cognitively normal older adults scanned at Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust (ICHT), categorized as SINGLE-SITE. The clinical cohort (n=86) was drawn from the Imperial Amyloid PET Cohort (Imperial APC), a real-world clinical cohort at ICHT.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The reference cohort consisted of a group of 33,072 cognitively normal adults pooled from publicly available neuroimaging datasets under a previous study"; "The adaptation dataset consisted of a group of 20 cognitively normal (CN) older adults who had an MRI scan at ICHT for research purposes."; Supplementary Table 1 footer: "ABCD = Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development, Cam-CAN = The Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience, CNP = The Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics, FCON = Functional Connectomes Project, HCP = Human Connectome Project, OASIS3 = Open Access Series of Imaging Studies, PNC = The Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort, TOP (Norwegian datasets), UKBB = UK Biobank"
